title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: siconfir R package provides direct access fiscal data SICONFI (Accounting Fiscal Information System Brazilian Public Sector) Brazilian National Treasury’s API. allows query data Brazilian states municipalities, including fiscal reports RREO, RGF, DCA, Accounting Balances Matrix (MSC).

title: Getting Started with siconfir
code: # Install from CRAN (when available) install.packages("siconfir")  # Or the development version from GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("StrategicProjects/siconfir")

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: Every function available two forms: English interface English parameter names, Portuguese interface matching original API parameter names. produce identical results – use whichever prefer: English functions also translate parameter names. example, fiscal_year maps an_exercicio, entity_id id_ente, . See function’s help page full mapping. Note function parameter names English, parameter values must still Portuguese come API (e.g., appendix = "RREO-Anexo 01").

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: common starting point list available entities. need IBGE code (cod_ibge) queries. can filter state, region, government sphere:
code: library(siconfir) library(dplyr)  entes <- get_entities() entes # State capitals capitals <- entes |>   filter(capital == 1)  # Municipalities in the state of Pernambuco municipalities_pe <- entes |>   filter(uf == "PE", esfera == "M")

what: Query the RREO (Budget Execution Summary Report)
title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: RREO published bimonthly. Use get_budget_report() (get_rreo()):
code: rreo <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   period      = 6,   report_type = "RREO",   appendix    = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 # Pernambuco )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: RGF published every four months:
code: rgf <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   periodicity = "Q",   period      = 3,   report_type = "RGF",   appendix    = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   branch      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: DCA contains annual balance sheet data:
code: dca <- get_annual_accounts(fiscal_year = 2023, entity_id = 26)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: find reports entity submitted:
code: status <- get_delivery_status(entity_id = 26, year = 2023)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: MSC provides detailed accounting data, split three segments: equity/assets (classes 1–4), budgetary (5–6), control (7–8).
code: # Equity/asset accounts msc_equity <- get_msc_equity(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 1,   value_type    = "ending_balance" )  # Budgetary accounts msc_budget <- get_msc_budget(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 6,   value_type    = "period_change" )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: package maintains -memory cache duration R session. call function parameters, data returned cache without hitting API . clear cache: can also disable cache specific call:
code: siconfir_clear_cache() entes <- get_entes(use_cache = FALSE)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: SICONFI API returns maximum 5,000 rows per page. siconfir handles pagination automatically, following hasMore / offset pattern data retrieved. Informative messages indicate many pages fetched many rows returned.

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: Use get_anexos() query reference table listing available appendices report type government sphere:
code: anexos <- get_anexos()  # Appendices available for the municipal RREO anexos |>   filter(esfera == "M", str_detect(anexo, "RREO"))

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: siconfir package wraps SICONFI API Brazil’s National Treasury. API natively Portuguese, package offers two parallel interfaces: English interface: English function names English parameter names (e.g., get_budget_report(fiscal_year = 2023)) Portuguese interface: names matching original API query parameters (e.g., get_rreo(an_exercicio = 2023)) interfaces call underlying API endpoints return identical tibbles. vignette provides complete reference parameter mappings, valid values, side--side examples every function. Note: function parameter names translated, parameter values response column names remain Portuguese come directly API (e.g., appendix = "RREO-Anexo 01", response column cod_ibge).

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: table lists every API query parameter, English alias, functions use . * MSC = get_msc_equity() / get_msc_budget() / get_msc_control()

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /entes required parameters. Returns registered government entities. Key response columns: cod_ibge, ente, capital, regiao, uf, esfera, populacao, co_cnpj.
code: library(siconfir)  # English entes <- get_entities()  # Portuguese (equivalent) entes <- get_entes()

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /anexos-relatorios required parameters. Returns reference table available report appendices. Key response columns: esfera, demonstrativo, anexo. Use discover valid appendix / no_anexo values functions:
code: # English anexos <- get_annexes()  # Portuguese (equivalent) anexos <- get_anexos() library(dplyr)  # What appendices exist for the municipal RREO? get_annexes() |>   filter(esfera == "M", str_detect(anexo, "RREO"))

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /dca Key response columns: exercicio, instituicao, cod_ibge, uf, anexo, rotulo, coluna, cod_conta, conta, valor, populacao.
code: # English dca <- get_annual_accounts(   fiscal_year = 2023,   entity_id   = 26  # Pernambuco )  # Portuguese (equivalent) dca <- get_dca(   an_exercicio = 2023,   id_ente      = 26 )  # With optional appendix filter dca_ab <- get_annual_accounts(   fiscal_year = 2023,   entity_id   = 26,   appendix    = "DCA-Anexo I-AB" )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /extrato_entregas Key response columns: exercicio, cod_ibge, instituicao, entregavel, periodo, periodicidade, status_relatorio, data_status, forma_envio, tipo_relatorio. Useful checking reports submitted querying :
code: # English status <- get_delivery_status(   entity_id = 26,   year      = 2023 )  # Portuguese (equivalent) status <- get_extrato(   id_ente       = 26,   an_referencia = 2023 ) library(dplyr)  # Which RREO periods did Pernambuco deliver in 2023? get_delivery_status(entity_id = 26, year = 2023) |>   filter(entregavel == "Relatório de Gestão Fiscal") |>   select(periodo, status_relatorio, data_status)

what: 5. Budget Execution Summary Report – get_budget_report() / get_rreo()
title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /rreo Valid values report_type: "RREO" – standard report (entities) "RREO Simplificado" – simplified report (municipalities 50k) Valid values sphere: "M" – municipalities "E" – states (including Federal District) "U" – federal government (union) Key response columns: exercicio, demonstrativo, periodo, instituicao, cod_ibge, uf, populacao, anexo, coluna, cod_conta, conta, valor.
code: # English -- 6th bimester for Pernambuco rreo <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   period      = 6,   report_type = "RREO",   appendix    = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 )  # Portuguese (equivalent) rreo <- get_rreo(   an_exercicio          = 2023,   nr_periodo            = 6,   co_tipo_demonstrativo = "RREO",   no_anexo              = "RREO-Anexo 01",   co_esfera             = "E",   id_ente               = 26 )  # Simplified RREO for a small municipality (Recife = 2611606) rreo_simpl <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   period      = 6,   report_type = "RREO Simplificado",   appendix    = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "M",   entity_id   = 2600104 )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /rgf Valid values branch / co_poder: "E" – Executive "L" – Legislative "J" – Judiciary "M" – Public Ministry "D" – Public Defender Valid values periodicity / in_periodicidade: "Q" – four-monthly (standard, 3 periods per year) "S" – semi-annual (simplified RGF , 2 periods per year) Key response columns: exercicio, periodo, periodicidade, instituicao, cod_ibge, uf, co_poder, populacao, anexo, coluna, cod_conta, conta, valor.
code: # English -- 3rd four-month period, executive branch, state level rgf <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   periodicity = "Q",   period      = 3,   report_type = "RGF",   appendix    = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   branch      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 )  # Portuguese (equivalent) rgf <- get_rgf(   an_exercicio          = 2023,   in_periodicidade      = "Q",   nr_periodo            = 3,   co_tipo_demonstrativo = "RGF",   no_anexo              = "RGF-Anexo 01",   co_esfera             = "E",   co_poder              = "E",   id_ente               = 26 )  # Legislative branch rgf_leg <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   periodicity = "Q",   period      = 3,   report_type = "RGF",   appendix    = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   branch      = "L",   entity_id   = 26 )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /msc_patrimonial Valid values matrix_type / co_tipo_matriz: "MSCC" – monthly aggregate matrix "MSCE" – annual closing matrix Valid values value_type / id_tv: "beginning_balance" – opening balance period "ending_balance" – closing balance period "period_change" – net movement period Valid values account_class / classe_conta: 1 – Assets (Ativo) 2 – Liabilities (Passivo) 3 – Net equity variations – additions (VPA) 4 – Net equity variations – deductions (VPD) Key response columns: tipo_matriz, cod_ibge, classe_conta, conta_contabil, poder_orgao, fonte_recursos, exercicio, mes_referencia, valor, natureza_conta, tipo_valor.
code: # English -- assets at year-end msc_assets <- get_msc_equity(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 1,   value_type    = "ending_balance" )  # Portuguese (equivalent) msc_assets <- get_msc_patrimonial(   id_ente        = 26,   an_referencia  = 2023,   me_referencia  = 12,   co_tipo_matriz = "MSCC",   classe_conta   = 1,   id_tv          = "ending_balance" )  # Liabilities movement during June msc_liab <- get_msc_equity(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 6,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 2,   value_type    = "period_change" )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /msc_orcamentaria parameters MSC equity, except: Account classes: 5 – Budgetary planning control - approved (Controle da aprovacao) 6 – Budgetary execution (Execucao orcamento) Key response columns: MSC equity, plus natureza_despesa, natureza_receita, funcao, subfuncao.
code: # English -- budgetary execution at year-end msc_exec <- get_msc_budget(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 6,   value_type    = "period_change" )  # Portuguese (equivalent) msc_exec <- get_msc_orcamentaria(   id_ente        = 26,   an_referencia  = 2023,   me_referencia  = 12,   co_tipo_matriz = "MSCC",   classe_conta   = 6,   id_tv          = "period_change" )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: Endpoint: /msc_controle parameters MSC equity, except: Account classes: 7 – -balance-sheet controls - debit (Controles devedores) 8 – -balance-sheet controls - credit (Controles credores) Key response columns: MSC equity, plus natureza_despesa, funcao, subfuncao.
code: # English -- control accounts at year-end msc_ctrl <- get_msc_control(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 8,   value_type    = "ending_balance" )  # Portuguese (equivalent) msc_ctrl <- get_msc_controle(   id_ente        = 26,   an_referencia  = 2023,   me_referencia  = 12,   co_tipo_matriz = "MSCC",   classe_conta   = 8,   id_tv          = "ending_balance" )

title: Parameter Mapping Reference
text: frequently used IBGE codes entity_id / id_ente: Use get_entities() look entity’s IBGE code:
code: library(dplyr)  get_entities() |>   filter(uf == "PE", capital == 1) |>   select(cod_ibge, ente, populacao)

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: Tidyverse-friendly: functions return tibbles snake_case column names. Automatic pagination: Fetches pages results transparently. -memory caching: Avoids redundant API calls within session. Informative messages: Uses cli clear progress error messages. Modern HTTP: Built httr2 automatic retries friendly error messages.

code: library(siconfir)  # List all entities entes <- get_entities()  # Budget Execution Summary (RREO) -- English interface rreo <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2022, period = 6,   report_type = "RREO", appendix = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere = "E", entity_id = 17  # Tocantins )  # Same call using the Portuguese interface: # rreo <- get_rreo( #   an_exercicio = 2022, nr_periodo = 6, #   co_tipo_demonstrativo = "RREO", no_anexo = "RREO-Anexo 01", #   co_esfera = "E", id_ente = 17 # )  # Fiscal Management Report (RGF) for Sao Paulo city rgf <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2022, periodicity = "Q", period = 3,   report_type = "RGF", appendix = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere = "M", branch = "E", entity_id = 3550308 )  # Annual accounts for Rondonia dca <- get_annual_accounts(fiscal_year = 2022, entity_id = 11)  # Clear the cache if needed siconfir_clear_cache()

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: SICONFI API provided Brazilian National Treasury : API returns 5,000 rows per page. siconfir handles pagination automatically, following hasMore / offset pattern data retrieved. Rate limit: API allows one request per second. package automatically retries failed requests 3 times progressive backoff provides clear, informative error messages connection issues.

what: siconfir: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API — siconfir-package
title: siconfir: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API — siconfir-package
text: Provides functions access fiscal data Brazilian National Treasury's SICONFI API https://apidatalake.tesouro.gov.br/docs/siconfi/. Includes budget execution reports (RREO), fiscal management reports (RGF), annual accounts declarations (DCA), accounting balances matrices (MSC), entity information Brazilian states municipalities. Features automatic pagination, -memory caching, tidy output.

title: siconfir 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Added get_anexos() report appendix reference table. Added get_entes() government entities listing. Added get_dca() Annual Accounts Declaration data. Added get_extrato() delivery status extract. Added get_rreo() Budget Execution Summary Report data. Added get_rgf() Fiscal Management Report data. Added get_msc_controle() MSC control accounts (classes 7-8). Added get_msc_orcamentaria() MSC budgetary accounts (classes 5-6). Added get_msc_patrimonial() MSC equity/asset accounts (classes 1-4). English aliases English parameter names: get_entities(), get_annexes(), get_annual_accounts(), get_delivery_status(), get_budget_report(), get_fiscal_report(), get_msc_control(), get_msc_budget(), get_msc_equity(). functions return tibbles. Automatic pagination fetch pages results. -memory session cache siconfir_clear_cache(). Built httr2 automatic retries informative error messages. Informative CLI messages via cli.
